items.title: Andrew Morgan Interview, 1961-07-04
items.q: Then we had another boy by the name of Tink. Oh yeah, is he the piano player? Piano player. Those were the only two piano players that made those records with Sam.

ctx.x: Then we had another. I forgot Walter DeCue was on that then.

Yeah, he's on the record, yes. Then we had another boy by the name of Tink. Oh yeah, is he the piano player? Piano player. Those were the only two piano players that made those records with Sam. But the rest of the men's is the men's that you've seen that made the records. It was the men's that was on this picture. No. I think Roy made, if I'm not making a mistake, Roy was playing the drum with us at the time we had made those records. Roy Evans.
I found the sheet I was looking for, but it doesn't have the name of that place on. I was trying to think of the name of the hall.
